name: GitLab
summary: DevOps platform for code hosting and CI/CD.

flows.title: Create a blank project
steps: In the upper-right corner, select Create new, then New project/repository.
Enter the project name and the project slug, which GitLab uses as the URL path, and select the visibility level. Optionally select Initialize repository with a README.

flows.title: Create an issue in a project
steps: In the top bar, select Search or go to and find the project.
In the left sidebar, select Plan > Work items, then select New item in the upper-right corner.
From the Type dropdown list, select Issue if it is not already selected.
Complete the fields and select Create issue. The new issue opens.

flows.title: Create a merge request
steps: In the top bar, select Search or go to and find the project.
In the left sidebar, select Code > Merge requests, then select New merge request in the upper-right corner.
Select a source and a target branch, then select Compare branches and continue.
Complete the fields on the New merge request page, then select Create merge request.
